structured.answer: Worth looking into: a חשבון ניירות ערך to buy an S&P 500 fund, the קרן השתלמות I already have, and maybe a קרן כספית for money I need on hand. But the page never tells me which to pick or what anything costs.

stuck.why: Three links (קרן השתלמות, קרן חדשה מקיפה, קרן כספית), but none of them is about putting a lump sum somewhere to grow, so I wasn't sure where I'm supposed to start

stuck.where: לבחירה עצמית heading at the bottom of screen 1
stuck.why: The heading is cut off from its cards, which only show up on the next screen, so at first I didn't know what the חשבון ניירות ערך cards belonged to
They all look alike and nothing says which one is better, so I just went with the S&P 500 because I'd heard of it

used: שני חלקים בכל חיסכון, first lines
skimmed: כסף שוטף וקצר cards (עו"ש, פיקדון, תכנית חיסכון)
קרן השתלמות / קופת גמל בניהול אישי
מזומן שקלי, אגרות חוב ממשלתיות, מסלול כללי
skipped: footer links and the date line
unsure_meaning: יומית / מתחדשת tags on קרן כספית
קרן חדשה מקיפה vs קרן חדשה כללית
קופת גמל להשקעה (sounds like something for old people)
not_found: Fees in shekels or any fee at all
Which option suits someone with 30,000 ₪ and a few hundred a month
What to do first / how to open a ניירות ערך account
Names of banks or investment houses

findings.what: There isn't a single number on the page: no fees, no returns, no example amount, so I can't compare anything or tell if something is cheap
Nothing tells you what to actually do first with savings you already have; מאיפה להתחיל only points at a pension and a קרן השתלמות
Every index card repeats the same 'הכסף מושקע בשקלים דרך קרן שעוקבת אחריו', so I had to reread it on each card to find what's different
A lot of jargon with no explanation (מק"מ, אג"ח, מנוטרלת, מתחדשת)
The לבחירה עצמית heading is separated from its cards
findings.where: Bottom of screen 1 / top of screen 2

findings.what: Lots of look-alike cards (index cards especially), and with this many similar options it feels easier to do nothing
